fields.label: Type Name
fields.description: Vendor name as shown in the AI Provider form, e.g. Sarvam.

fields.label: Adapter Path
fields.description: Dotted path to a BaseProvider subclass. Leave the default for any vendor that speaks the OpenAI chat-completions format.

fields.label: Default Base URL
fields.description: e.g. https://api.sarvam.ai — an AI Provider may override this.

fields.label: Models Path
fields.description: Leave blank if the vendor has no model-listing endpoint; models are then entered by hand.

fields.label: No Credential Required
fields.description: Adapter authenticates itself (a local CLI or an unauthenticated endpoint). Hides the key fields on the AI Provider.

fields.label: Auth Header
fields.description: Header carrying the credential. Sarvam also accepts api-subscription-key.

fields.label: Auth Prefix
fields.description: Prepended to the credential. Blank for raw-key headers.

fields.label: Default Billing Currency
fields.description: Currency the vendor prices in. Sarvam bills in INR.

fields.label: Pricing Source URL
fields.description: Optional JSON catalog used to prefill rates and capabilities for models with no hand-entered values. Clear this to disable all outbound catalog lookups.

fields.label: Catalog Key Prefix
fields.description: Optional prefix tried when matching a model id in the catalog, e.g. anthropic/ for anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.

fields.label: Unsupported Parameters
fields.description: Comma or newline separated request keys this vendor rejects; stripped before sending. Sarvam: stream_options, max_completion_tokens, service_tier
